review_scope: Primary read the full first-pass report and independently read the full generator, browser JavaScript and controls.json. The reviewer read all remaining required files completely.
decision: Keep all four baseline labels. The destination varies through tank depth and height; orbiting changes the view used to locate it. Held/persistent torque has continuing effects on angular rate and velocity, and success requires a multi-tick low-speed upright arrival. Propulsion and orientation choices affect subsequent motion, braking and final settling.

rationale_clarifications.exploration_interface: The orbit is counted as active spatial inspection of target depth, not because the key bindings are unknown; those bindings and telemetry are explicitly displayed.

uncertainties: Source-based baseline labels and profile review; no all-seed human/agent calibration or dedicated temporal diagnostic was performed.
